name: 03_flight
js: (()=>{ __tunl.freeze(); startPlay(); const onScreen=(a,f)=>a.filter(o=>{const sx=(o.wx!==undefined?o.wx:0)-scrollX; return sx>-20&&sx<W+40&&(!f||f(o,sx));}).length; const wallsIn=()=>{const b=boundsAt(scrollX+PX); return b.top>H*0.03 && b.bot<H*0.97;}; let bestS=-1, bestT=0; const r=__tunl.run(12000, ()=>{ if(score<340 || phase!=='play') return false; if(!(milestoneFlash<=0 && levelIntroT<=0 && notifs.length===0 && wallsIn())) return false; const st=onScreen(stalactites,(o,sx)=>sx>PX-20), co=onScreen(coins,(o,sx)=>!o.collected&&sx>PX); const combo=(coinCombo>=2 && coinComboTimer>coinComboWindow*0.45)?1:0; const sc2=st*1.0+co*1.4+combo*3; if(sc2>bestS){bestS=sc2;bestT=scrollX;} return st>=4 && co>=2; }); draw(); return JSON.stringify({score, ok:r.ok, bestS}); })()

name: 04_portal
js: (()=>{ __tunl.freeze(); startPlay(); const wallsIn=()=>{const b=boundsAt(scrollX+PX); return b.top>H*0.02 && b.bot<H*0.98;}; const r=__tunl.run(12000, ()=> score>=150 && milestoneFlash<=0 && levelIntroT<=0 && notifs.length===0 && wallsIn() && portals.some(p=>!p.used && (p.wx-scrollX) > W*0.38 && (p.wx-scrollX) < W*0.80)); draw(); return JSON.stringify({score, ok:r.ok}); })()

name: 05_deep
js: (()=>{ __tunl.freeze(); startPlay(); const onScreen=(a,f)=>a.filter(o=>{const sx=(o.wx!==undefined?o.wx:0)-scrollX; return sx>-20&&sx<W+40&&(!f||f(o,sx));}).length; const wallsIn=()=>{const b=boundsAt(scrollX+PX); return b.top>H*0.03 && b.bot<H*0.97;}; const r=__tunl.run(12000, ()=>{ if(score>430) shieldCount=Math.max(shieldCount,2); return score>=680 && milestoneFlash<=0 && levelIntroT<=0 && notifs.length===0 && wallsIn() && bulletAmmo<=0 && onScreen(stalactites,(o,sx)=>sx>PX-60)>=4; }); draw(); return JSON.stringify({score, ok:r.ok, shieldCount}); })()
